mesh.title: Mesh Compass — Node Radar
mesh.desc: The only messenger with a visual radar of nearby relay nodes. Works without internet, cellular or power grid — up to 50 km range.
hero.title: Meet Mess&Anger
hero.sub: Decentralized messenger with post-quantum encryption.\nNo servers. No phone number. No compromises.
stats.label: By the numbers
cmp.label: Comparison
cmp.title:
Why not Telegram
or Signal?
cmp.desc: All popular messengers store your data on their servers. Mess&Anger is the only one where data lives exclusively on your device.
feat.label: Features
feat.title:
Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.
feat.desc: Every feature ships with privacy and security baked in. No toggle to turn off — because you shouldn't have to choose between usability and anonymity.
feat.p1: WebRTC creates an encrypted tunnel directly between you and your contact. No server ever sees your messages — there's nothing in between.
feat.p2: Dual encryption. ML-KEM-768 approved by NIST in 2024 — resistant to quantum computer attacks for decades ahead.
feat.p3: Identity is your cryptographic fingerprint. Add contacts via QR code, username, or nexus:// link.
sec.label: Security architecture
sec.title:
10 layers
of protection
sec.desc: Security score 8.5/10. From RFC 5869 HKDF to Tor bridges. Each layer is independent — if one is compromised, the rest hold.
sec.l3: Unique key per message. On all chats, not just secret.
sec.l6: AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 for storage at rest. 600k iterations.
stars.label: Stars Economy
stars.title:
Earn by
supporting the network
stars.desc: Stars is a local reward system. Not crypto, not blockchain. Just motivation for those who keep the network alive.
ac.label: Anti-censorship
ac.title:
Impossible
to block
ac.desc: 5 resistance levels. If one is unavailable — automatic switch. Traffic is indistinguishable from regular HTTPS for any DPI.
ac.l1d: Standard P2P. Direct encrypted tunnel with no intermediaries.
ac.l3d: Fake TLS headers, XOR, random padding, timing jitter.
ac.l4d: Via CDN. DPI sees only CDN request, not the peer.
manifesto.quote:
«Your conversations are yours alone.
Even we cannot read them.»
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title:
Frequently
asked questions
faq.q1: What if I lose my phone?
faq.a1: If you created a backup (.mess file) — restore your account on a new device. Without a backup, data is lost forever.
faq.a2: Practically impossible. Traffic is obfuscated and indistinguishable from HTTPS. If WebRTC is blocked — WebSocket tunnel activates automatically.
faq.a3: Only you and the recipient. Messages are encrypted on your device and decrypted only on the recipient's device.
faq.a4: Encryption resistant to future quantum computers. ML-KEM-768 approved by NIST in 2024.
faq.q5: How do I add a contact?
faq.a5: Scan a QR code, find by username, or get a nexus:// link. There is no central address book.
faq.a6: No. Stars is a local activity reward system. No blockchain, no market value.
